sharedChangePolicy: Each shared extension gets its own focused commit and a recorded integration entry with files, hash, compatibility behavior, and checks. Keep prerequisite-specific edits out of this branch. Fetch main at integration boundaries; merge or otherwise incorporate it only in this worktree without rewriting published prerequisite history. Review conflicts rather than replacing files wholesale.
releaseGates: All 22 mapped lessons contain actual teaching, examples, practice, checkpoint, accessible investigation, and verified readings; no plan or unavailable lesson is counted as authored.
Every planned family and variant has deterministic 50-seed tests and independent reference answers or physical invariants, with explicit critical and invalid-input cases.
Every objective is present in module and cumulative assessment coverage; targeted repair and project evidence are usable.
Progress survives reload and export/import; existing backups still parse; a realistic full-course history fits the tested capacity policy or the policy is extended compatibly with visible recovery.
Visual review covers wide and narrow layouts, table overflow, math, focus, labels, keyboard-only actions, zoom, and reduced motion.
All relevant automated checks pass and published availability matches the delivered content.
Independent subject review and pilot validation remain explicitly unperformed until evidence exists. A technical preview is not relabeled reviewed.
remainingWork: All lessons, interactions, generators, course assessments, targeted review, project notebook and repeated-study capacity checks are implemented. Finish the fresh integrated unit/lint/type/build/browser run, coverage audit, release copy and final visual checks. Record actual evidence before technical-preview release. Begin PHS 232 only after that audit; independent subject review and pilot validation have not occurred.
